2609.24359.title: Dissecting Agentic Forensics: The Role of Triage, Prompting, and Evidence Arbitration in Open-World Fake Image Detection
2609.24359.paper_summary: Image forensics is increasingly an open-world problem: manipulations range from fully synthetic images to localized edits, splicing and swapping, while most forensic detectors remain specialized to a single manipulation family. Agentic AI has recently emerged as a promising solution. In principle, such systems can assess the reliability of individual detectors, identify out-of-scope evidence, and arbitrate conflicting reports. However, it remains unclear which components actually drive performance and whether their benefits persist under distribution shift. To answer these questions, we study a training-free agentic framework built around specialist detectors, per-detector triage, and conflict-aware evidence arbitration. Using six configurations and three multimodal large language model backbones, we dissect the role of triage, prompting, and reasoning quality on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data. Our results show that naive detector fusion suffers from severe false-positive rates on authentic images. Triage and prompting consistently improve performance by filtering unreliable evidence and exposing detector limitations. However, the dominant factor is represented by reasoning itself: A stronger judge substantially outperforms a weaker one, particularly under distribution shift. Most notably, manipulation recall is nearly saturated across all configurations, indicating that the main challenge of open-world image forensics is not detecting manipulations, but calibrating trust in specialized forensic tools and arbitrating conflicting evidence.
2609.24359.paper_summary_zh: 影像取證越來越成為一個開放世界的問題：操控範圍從完全合成的影像到局部編輯、拼接和交換，而大多數取證檢測器仍然專注於單一的操控類別。代理 AI 最近出現，成為一個有前景的解決方案。原則上，這類系統可以評估個別檢測器的可靠性，識別超出範疇的證據，並仲裁衝突報告。然而，目前尚不清楚哪些組件實際上驅動性能，以及它們的好處是否在分佈變化下持續存在。為了回答這些問題，我們研究了一個不需要訓練的代理框架，該框架圍繞專家檢測器、每個檢測器的分流和衝突意識的證據仲裁構建。使用六種配置和三種多模態大型語言模型骨幹，我們剖析了分流、提示和推理質量在內部分佈和外部分佈數據上的作用。我們的結果顯示，天真的檢測器融合在真實影像上遭受嚴重的假陽性率。分流和提示通過過濾不可靠的證據和揭示檢測器的局限性，持續改善性能。然而，主導因素是推理本身：一個更強的判斷者在性能上大幅超越一個較弱的判斷者，特別是在分佈變化下。最值得注意的是，在所有配置中，操控的召回率幾乎達到飽和，這表明開放世界影像取證的主要挑戰不是檢測操控，而是校準對專業取證工具的信任並仲裁衝突證據。
